S9 (Latest) 8.8 / 10

Session 9: The DC Precinct Heist & The Flight 840 Vision

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Operating under strict time and alarm pressure, the coterie executes a multi-vector heist against the Metropolitan Police Department Third Precinct in Washington, D.C. While a crashing gargoyle and Dravin's administrative double-talk draw frontline police away, Pierre scales the exterior fire escape and Alfie smuggles inside an evidence carton.

When Eusacles batters the vault frame to stage a diversion, Dravin swipes Captain Brenda Bob's keycard and Alfie isolates pursuing officers with Vicious Mockery. Extracting the anomalous silver handcuffs from the Captain's office, Dravin experiences a psychic chronal flashback to 1974 Flight 840 over the Atlantic, witnessing an operative observing a ticking device as the transponder shears from DOA to DCA. The party exfiltrates through stormwater culverts into the boatman's punt, returning safely to The Margin.

S8 7.8 / 10

Session 8: Infiltration, The Lost Roads & The DC Precinct Vault

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Advancing to 5th level at The Margin, the party receives critical birthrights—including Theodore's ancestral boon to Eusacles and Prof. Dravin's 3-seed pomegranate signet pin—before embarking toward Washington, D.C. Guided along Lost Creek's subterranean aqueducts by a reticent boatman, they repel swarming ink-blot stalkers as tracking clocks begin ticking toward Majora.

Reaching a storm drain opposite the D.C. police precinct, Dravin analyzes downloaded blueprints, Sharpie-inscribes Alfie's foot with contact info, and hurls a brick through a patrol cruiser window before casting Meld into Stone to slip Alfie inside. With a living stone statue sent by Pierre's mother shattering the front portico to create mass panic, Dravin is swept into the processing room where Alfie rests inside a tagged evidence brick as the cliffhanger incursion begins.

S7 9.5 / 10

Session 7: The Interrogation, The Redactor & The Dream of Thanatos

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Tucked away in an abandoned campus arcade at University University, the party interrogates their captive Redactor operative, discovering that the mysterious 'Master' is curating a utopian timeline and that the travelers have become living anomaly vessels targeted for elimination.

When the captive mocks Alfie, the driftwood duelist executes her with a needle rapier, triggering a blinding violet signal flare that draws an ink-cloaked, six-fingered stalker. Fleeing into the misty Lost Roads behind Pierre's luminous rabbit patronus, the company rescues Susanna. At a secluded campfire, Thanatos visits Eusacles in a divine dream, granting an ancestral ward upon his watch and warning of Pierre's maternal heritage.

S6 9.3 / 10

Session 6: The Auditorium Incursion & The Memory Seam

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Violent planar combat erupts across the University University amphitheater as satyr strike teams and a tendril-grafted Gorgon operative assault the party amidst student protests.

Dravin establishes a defensive sanctuary of moonlight while Eusacles smites intruders before suffering a cognitive memory siphon. Pierre manifests defensive stone barriers to hold the perimeter, allowing Alfie to sever the Gorgon's tendrils and capture an operative as the alarm klaxons blare.

S5 9.0 / 10

Session 5: The Forgotten Trail & The Mad Doctor's Lecture

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

A celestial dispatch delivered by Hermes bears a sealed winter warning from Persephone, alerting the Margin that planar veils are thinning across North America.

Traveling across the Lost Roads to University University in Pennsylvania, the company infiltrates a chaotic lecture hall amidst student unrest surrounding medical historian Dr. Aris Thorne, uncovering encrypted notes regarding the 1948 Big Pox trials.

S4 9.2 / 10

Session 4: The Raleigh Museum Gorgon Ambush & Debrief

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Ambushed inside the Aegean antiquity wing of the North Carolina Museum of Natural History by serpent-crowned Gorgon Redactors, the company mounts a desperate defense utilizing improvised baguette explosives, a high-altitude clay urn drop, and salvaged ancient armor.

Touching the fractured Gorgon stele, Alfie is overwhelmed by a traumatic vision of ancient oarsmen and a burning coastal port. Surviving the clash, the party secures the relic and flees through the emergency exits into the foggy outskirts of Raleigh.

S3 8.7 / 10

Session 3: The Museum Heist in North Carolina

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Threading through the dimensional mist of the Lost Roads, the company arrives in downtown Raleigh to infiltrate the North Carolina Museum of Natural History.

Donning academic disguises, Pierre bluffs security as a visiting Sorbonne intern while Alfie deploys Wordcraft to trigger a spectral sheep distraction in the lobby, allowing Dravin to map security blind spots and locate the subterranean Aegean stele vault.

S2 8.5 / 10

Session 2: The Margin, The Fragments & The Lost Roads

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Within the timeless mountain refuge of The Margin, Teddy reveals the sanctuary's 1846 surveyor origins as a crease in reality where calendar decay cannot reach.

While Naomi organizes defensive blackout drills and briefs the company on four scattered timeline Fragments, Pierre inadvertently triggers his ancient petrifying Gorgon gaze during an encounter at a rural station before boarding a vintage farm truck into the Lost Roads.

S1 8.8 / 10

Session 1: The Bus from Vegas & The Library of the Fates

📖 Full Narrative
Quick Summary

Displaced from a midnight Las Vegas Greyhound bus into dimensional freefall, four disparate strangers awaken inside the marble colonnades of the celestial Library of the Fates.

As predatory ink-beasts tear through the stacks to consume severed timeline threads, the Three Fates rapidly weave Alfie from driftwood and sea-thread to bolster the frontline. Escaping through a cosmic tapestry rift, the survivors tumble into the Appalachian threshold of The Margin.
